business.description: The company has not done any business during the year under review except earning other income by way of fees and commission. Directors are actively considering various avenues of business.

outlook.statement: India is expected to remain the fastest growing economy among all the countries covered by global investment. Urbanization and infrastructure development, expected expanded markets, boosted productivity, attracted investments and creation of millions of new jobs, will be the central driver of India's economic growth. Directors look forward a better future of the Company.

risks: global microeconomic environment continues to be confronted with myriad challenges including continuing impact of the Russia-Ukraine conflict, unrest in Middle-East west Asian countries, thereby adversely affecting the supply chain mainly crude supply
Indian economy is also facing headwind of inflationary pressure created due to global unrest
Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses, fully eroded net worth, and current liabilities exceeding current assets
Company is a deemed NBFC which may entail regulatory risks
Market risk, credit risk and liquidity risk could have significant influence on the Company
Currency risk on account of operating and financing activities, exposure mainly denominated in U.S. dollars
Interest rate risk through impact of rate changes on interest-bearing liabilities and assets

related_party.nature: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Act where applicable and details disclosed in financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards

auditor.name: Kochar & Associates
auditor.opinion: According to Directors, there are no adverse remarks made by Statutory Auditors in their report.
key_audit_matters: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company has accumulated losses and its net worth has been fully eroded and the Company's current liabilities exceeded its current assets as at the balance sheet date. These conditions indicate the existence of a material uncertainty that may cast significant doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.
qualifications_or_emphasis: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern (emphasis of matter, opinion not modified)
